prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one transparent RGBA texture atlas for painting distant woodland crowns in an Italian hill-town game environment. Create a square atlas with exactly four distinct mature broadleaf tree crowns in a clean 2 by 2 arrangement: one broad deciduous oak, one denser Mediterranean holm oak, one uneven beech, and one loose willow. Each crown must fit fully inside its own quadrant with a generous transparent margin and no overlap. Camera: strictly vertical orthographic aerial view, directly down onto the top of the crown; no side view, no horizon, no trunk. Make the four silhouettes different and naturally asymmetric, with branching lobes, small gaps between sprays of leaves, fine individual leaf texture, and varied foliage density. Photographic detail like a high-quality aerial vegetation scan. Muted natural olive and deep green palette, healthy late-summer trees; no neon green, no autumn orange. Lighting: diffuse neutral overcast daylight, subtle natural self-shadow inside foliage clusters, no directional cast shadow and no ground or shadow underneath. Preserve fine natural alpha edges and real transparent holes between leaves. Output only the four crowns on actual transparent background. No labels, captions, borders, grid lines, watermark, grass, soil, buildings or sky. This is a reusable game texture, not concept art or a game screenshot.
